data.name: CodeGen_Error_MultiTargetEfCoreExclusive
data.value: EF Core generation cannot be combined with multi-target custom Repositories (two or more effective dialects). Narrow it to a single dialect or disable EF Core (the two are mutually exclusive).

data.name: CodeGen_Error_InMemoryRuntimePackagesExclusive
data.value: In-memory Repository generation cannot be combined with the runtime package reference mode (UseRuntimePackages). The in-memory executor is emitted as fixed code on the generated side, so in a package reference mode that does not emit fixed code it loses its reference target. Disable UseRuntimePackages (emit the fixed code inline) or disable in-memory generation.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_TypeMismatch
data.value: Column '{1}' of table '{0}' resolves to different C# types across dialects ({2}: {3} / {4}: {5}). The shared Entity is a single type, so both dialects must resolve to the same C# type.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_NoGenerationTarget
data.value: None of Entity / EditModel / Mapper / Repository / EF Core / in-memory Repository is selected for generation. Enable at least one.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_MapperRequiresEntityAndEditModel
data.value: Generating a Mapper requires both the Entity class and the EditModel class. Include both as generation targets.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_RepositoryRequiresEntity
data.value: Generating a Repository / EF Core / in-memory Repository requires the Entity class. Include Entity as a generation target.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_RepositoryRequiresDataAnnotations
data.value: Repository / EF Core / in-memory Repository use the [Table] / [Key] / [Column] attributes, so data annotations must be applied. Enable data annotations.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_NoEntities
data.value: The ER diagram has no entities.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_EmptyTableName
data.value: There is an entity with an empty table name.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_CompositeKey
data.value: Table '{0}' has a composite primary key, so [Key] attribute generation is minimal. A single primary key is recommended for the MVP.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_NonGeneratedFileOverwrite
data.value: Only generated files can be overwritten. The output file name must end with .g.cs or .g.md.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_EntityDisplayNameCollision
data.value: Entity '{0}' (table '{1}') has a column-derived property name that collides with DisplayName / CustomizeDisplayName, so the static DisplayName property and the CustomizeDisplayName hook were not generated.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_EditModelDisplayNameCollision
data.value: EditModel '{0}' (table '{1}') has a column-derived property name that collides with the display-name helpers GetDisplayName / CustomizePropertyDisplayName, so the display-name mechanism was not generated and validation messages use property names as before.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_RepositorySingleKeyOnly
data.value: The Repository for table '{0}' supports single primary keys only, so its generation was skipped.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_ManyToManySkipped
data.value: Many-to-many relationship '{0}' is out of scope for C# generation and was skipped.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_RelationshipTargetNotFound
data.value: Relationship '{0}' was skipped because its referenced entity was not found.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_RelationshipKeyUnknown
data.value: Relationship '{0}' was skipped for navigation generation because its keys are unknown.

data.name: CodeGen_Warning_ValueObjectDefinitionMismatch
data.value: The definitions of the same-named columns aggregated into value object '{0}' do not match. Generation proceeds with the PK definition preferred (otherwise the largest definition), but unifying the definitions in the ER diagram is recommended: {1}
